assignments.goal: Reproduce and specify a browser-level Repair and Resume fault-injection matrix for the current implementation, including detached DOM, interrupted generation, route replacement, transient unavailable controls, stale lease/state, and duplicate-resume prevention.
assignments.rationale: RR-E2E-FAULTS is the earliest unfinished release-critical program; implementation must follow verified browser failure contracts rather than assumptions.
acceptanceCriteria: Map each fault to current observable behavior and expected safe recovery
Identify exact fixture hooks and deterministic injection points
Define duplicate-resume and uncertain-Send negative assertions
Add a focused specification or failing fixture test when feasible
Record primary browser/platform sources only where external behavior is claimed
requiredTests: Run any added focused Jest or Playwright specification test
Record existing relevant test results or NOT TESTED
assignments.fallbackWork: If browser execution is unavailable, produce the deterministic fixture/specification test and exact Playwright commands without changing production code.

assignments.goal: Implement the smallest Repair and Resume browser fault-injection fixtures and regression coverage required by Worker 2's accepted contract; change production code only when a reproduced test proves a defect.
assignments.rationale: The builder follows the research contract and keeps changes reviewable and evidence-driven.
acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic browser faults cover the Worker 2 matrix slice
No duplicate resume or duplicate send occurs
Detached/replaced controls recover or stop safely
Generated extension artifact parity is preserved when production code changes
All required focused gates pass before commit
requiredTests: npm run check:generated when production changes
assignments.fallbackWork: If Worker 2 exposes no product defect, add only the deterministic browser fixtures/regression tests and record no production change.

assignments.goal: Attempt to falsify Worker 3's Repair and Resume coverage using races, repeated subtree replacement, route changes, stale state, uncertain Send, and rapid pause/resume sequences.
assignments.rationale: Repair paths are safety-critical and need independent negative-path evidence before acceptance.
acceptanceCriteria: Exercise at least one race and one repeated-DOM-replacement case
Verify exactly-once resume/send authority
Verify uncertainty stops rather than guesses
Verify route and lease transitions do not resurrect stale work
File failing evidence rather than masking failures
assignments.fallbackWork: If browser execution is blocked, add adversarial deterministic tests that fail on the unsafe behavior and submit them without changing production code.

assignments.goal: Evaluate the round's Repair and Resume path under mobile Chromium viewport/lifecycle pressure and measure whether recovery polling, observers, timers, or repeated scans remain bounded.
assignments.rationale: A browser fault fix that is correct on desktop can still regress Android and lower-end devices.
acceptanceCriteria: Run or define a mobile Chromium fault scenario
Record timer/observer/scan counts or bounded proxies
Check viewport resize and background/foreground transitions where harness permits
Confirm no accessibility-visible duplicate status/control is introduced
State Firefox/mobile gaps explicitly
requiredTests: Playwright mobile Chromium project or equivalent emulation
assignments.fallbackWork: If mobile browser execution is unavailable, add deterministic instrumentation assertions and document the exact CI/browser command needed.

assignments.goal: Audit every round-1 assignment, commit, diff, test claim, CI run, generated parity result, and evidence file; accept, reject, or require more evidence for each assignment and close the round for human verification.
assignments.rationale: Review-after-round mode requires an independent evidence audit before any roadmap progress is credited.
acceptanceCriteria: Review all worker evidence and referenced commits
Verify clean-head CI and generated parity where claimed
Mark each assignment accepted/rejected/needs-more-evidence with reasons
Reject safety regressions or unsupported completion
Set awaiting-human-verification and release lease
requiredTests: Re-run or inspect authoritative clean-head gates as needed
Verify CI run IDs and conclusions
assignments.fallbackWork: When evidence is missing, mark needs-more-evidence or rejected; do not infer success.
